content.dlg.halvard.halvard-choice.opt.0.label: 回家吧，哈尔瓦德
content.dlg.halvard.halvard-choice.opt.0.tooltip: 王座上的人，已不是你宣誓效忠的那位国王。
content.dlg.halvard.halvard-choice.opt.1.label: 守住那扇门
content.dlg.halvard.halvard-choice.opt.1.tooltip: 国王仍需要有人替他守门。
content.dlg.halvard.halvard-choice.opt.2.label: 你会怎么做？
content.dlg.halvard.halvard-choice.text: “诸位在这座城里上上下下走了一遍。请直言相告：我的国王还活着吗？若他已不在，请告诉我，我便回家。若他还在，我便先行一步，替他守住那扇门。”
content.dlg.halvard.halvard-cloister.opt.0.label: 我们还不知道
content.dlg.halvard.halvard-cloister.opt.1.label: 哪扇门？
content.dlg.halvard.halvard-cloister.text: “守望的朋友们。在下哈尔瓦德·德雷爵士，誓守国王之门。是哪一扇，我已记不起了。诸位可曾见到国王？他还活着吗？”
content.dlg.halvard.halvard-dont-know.text: “那我便守到诸位知晓为止。我不瞒诸位：我怕你们回来告诉我他已经死了，那样我就不知道自己还为何而在。”
content.dlg.halvard.halvard-door.opt.0.label: 返回
content.dlg.halvard.halvard-door.text: “每天清晨我择一扇门，守在那里。这是我至少能做的。”
content.dlg.halvard.halvard-tower.opt.0.label: 请问吧
content.dlg.halvard.halvard-tower.opt.1.label: 稍后再说
content.dlg.halvard.halvard-tower.text: 哈尔瓦德把他的守望挪到了城墙顶上。“守望的朋友们。这段城墙还不安全。等安全了，我有一事相询。”
content.dlg.halvard.halvard-what.opt.0.label: 返回
content.dlg.halvard.halvard-what.text: “诸位怎么说，我便怎么做。十年来我每天清晨都要择一扇门。我择得累了。”
content.dlg.ilse-hesk.hesk-cost.opt.0.label: 那个女孩是谁？
content.dlg.ilse-hesk.hesk-cost.opt.1.label: 为何还要敲？
content.dlg.ilse-hesk.hesk-cost.text: “敲一次，丢一天。我把丢的是哪天记下来，总得有个东西替我留着。”她念道：“‘解冻月初八。那天有一首歌。’那首歌我已经不记得了。只知道有过。”
content.dlg.ilse-hesk.hesk-girl.opt.0.label: 为何还要敲？
content.dlg.ilse-hesk.hesk-girl.text: “那是学徒。账簿上说，她是我女儿。”她说这话时没有回头。“我害怕有一天，连看着纸上的字也认不出她。我怕这个，比怕遗忘之潮还怕。”
content.dlg.ilse-hesk.hesk-root.opt.0.label: 要付出什么？
content.dlg.ilse-hesk.hesk-root.opt.1.label: 那个女孩是谁？
content.dlg.ilse-hesk.hesk-root.text: 守钟人从账簿上抬起头，仿佛你们一直都在。“早上好。诸位是新来宫里的吗？如今在我眼里人人都是新来的。今晚由我敲晚祷钟。”
content.dlg.ilse-hesk.hesk-why.opt.0.label: 我们会记住
content.dlg.ilse-hesk.hesk-why.text: “因为我一停，灰潮就会涌上来，一下子拿走所有人的日子，而不是一天一天只拿我的。”她把一把沉重的钥匙挂上祭坛边的钩子。“钟塔的门。留给我之后敲钟的人。”
content.dlg.pellam.pellam-after.opt.0.label: 你出卖了我们
content.dlg.pellam.pellam-after.opt.1.label: 告辞
content.dlg.pellam.pellam-after.text: 佩拉姆不敢看你。“他们给得多。换你们也一样。毯子还铺着呢，要是你们还买的话。”
content.dlg.pellam.pellam-monk.opt.0.label: 返回
content.dlg.pellam.pellam-monk.text: “当然。当了好多年。要么就是从修士那儿买了这身袍子。”他皱起眉。“两句里有一句是真的。”
content.dlg.pellam.pellam-root.opt.0.label: 从哪儿来的？
content.dlg.pellam.pellam-root.opt.1.label: 你当过修士？
content.dlg.pellam.pellam-root.opt.2.label: 告辞
content.dlg.pellam.pellam-root.text: “佩拉姆修士，朝圣者之友，专卖死人用不着的东西。毯子就铺在柜台边。只收蜡脂。”
content.dlg.pellam.pellam-sold.opt.0.label: 告辞
content.dlg.pellam.pellam-sold.text: “我什么都卖，朋友。这是我身上唯一一句真话。”
content.dlg.pellam.pellam-where.opt.0.label: 返回
content.dlg.pellam.pellam-where.text: “这儿那儿。主要是那儿。俗话说得好，死人身上的外套，放着也是凉了。”
content.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-hire.opt.0.label: 那座堡是什么？
content.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-hire.opt.1.label: 你想要什么？
content.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-hire.opt.2.label: 我们去
content.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-hire.text: “你们就是揭了告示的人。坐。吃点东西。那座堡谁来都不开门，所以得你们自己把它打开。”
content.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-hold.opt.0.label: 返回
content.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-hold.text: “维斯珀堡。一个国王，一群廷臣，一口钟。十年前钟停了。从那以后城门一直关着，里面的人没有一个记得为什么要关着。”
content.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-throne.opt.0.label: 再敲响它
content.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-throne.opt.0.tooltip: 城堡记起一切，塔姆辛开始遗忘。
content.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-throne.opt.1.label: 让它沉默吧
content.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-throne.opt.1.tooltip: 守望结束，城堡遗忘自己。
content.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-throne.opt.2.label: 为何告诉我们？
content.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-throne.text: 塔姆辛看着国王，看了很久。“钟是我敲裂的。那年我十五岁。那天晚上她要是再敲一次，就会把我彻底忘了，所以我拿锤子砸了它。”她举起母亲的账簿。“只要有人接过绳子，它就能再响。那个人会是我。要么我们就让它沉默，把灰潮放出去。”
content.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-tongue.opt.0.label: 为什么？
content.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-tongue.opt.1.label: 去礼拜堂
content.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-tongue.text: “这是她的钟舌。晚祷钟的。”她没有伸手碰。“礼拜堂祭坛上有她的一块碎片。拿这个去贴上。礼拜堂会想起她还在响的时候是什么样子。我不进去。”
content.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-want.opt.0.label: 你和它什么关系？
content.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-want.opt.1.label: 返回
content.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-want.text: “城堡底下有钟的一块东西。钟舌。我要把它找回来。找回来以后怎么办，我不知道。这点我说的是实话。”
content.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-who.opt.0.label: 返回
content.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-who.text: “我以前替守钟人提过灯。你们知道这个就够了。”
content.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-why-tell.opt.0.label: 返回
content.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-why-tell.text: “因为是你们把她在这座城里扛上扛下。你们有资格说话。”
content.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-why.opt.0.label: 去礼拜堂
content.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-why.text: “因为我知道它会给你们看什么。我怕。去吧。”
content.dlg.young-tamsin.apprentice-hammer.text: “没有钟，就没什么可敲的。就这样。这就是全部计划。”
content.dlg.young-tamsin.apprentice-root.text: 女孩没有看你。“她今天早上问我叫什么。问了两次。所以别跟我讲什么对不对。今晚她不许敲。”
content.fx.beneath-the-psalter.done.0.narrate: 一道阶梯从水池边爬向一扇门。塔姆辛会想看看这个。
content.fx.death.1.narrate: 你在上次歇息的火边醒来。身上带的东西，留在了你倒下的地方。

content.fx.shop.pellam.9.1.narrate: “钟塔那扇门，谁敲三下都给开。”他说得非常笃定。
content.fx.the-bell-road.done.0.narrate: 阶梯通向钟楼。上面有个东西，没有钟也在敲。
佩拉姆的火盆。除了这点暖意，他什么都要收钱。
content.fx.the-bell-road.oc.wake-the-second-shar: 头顶上，本该挂钟的地方有根绳子在吱呀作响。
佩拉姆的声音从你身后传来：“别往心里去，朋友们。他们给得多。”
content.fx.the-causeway-fire.done.0.narrate: 门后有东西在来回踱步。
content.fx.the-causeway-fire.oc.hear-tamsin.0.re: 火把你外套上的雨气烤干了。
content.fx.the-causeway-fire.oc.hear-tamsin.2.se: 边门锁着。看门人身上有钥匙。
content.fx.the-causeway-fire.oc.hear-tamsin.3.se: 主堡大门从里面闩上了。
content.fx.the-causeway-fire.oc.hear-tamsin.4.se: 守卫长之门锁着。钥匙在守卫长手里。
content.fx.the-cloister-fire.oc.find-the-cloiste: 雨从拱廊上滴下来。庭院很静。
content.fx.the-keep.oc.reach-the-antechamber.0.r: 帷幕后面，有个很大的东西呼出一口气。
content.fx.the-keep.oc.reach-the-antechamber.2.n: 哈尔瓦德爵士站在门口，手握长剑，低着头。他已经死了一个时辰。他仍守着那扇门。
content.fx.the-keep.oc.reach-the-antechamber.4.n: 门框上新刻着一行字：“回家了。H。”
content.fx.the-king-who-kept-the-watch.done.0.na: 国王清清楚楚地说：“关好城门。”然后便再没有说话。
content.fx.the-last-vesper.oc.choose.0.seq.1.0.n: 下面的外庭里，一个士兵把床头铭牌上的名字念出了声。
content.fx.the-last-vesper.oc.choose.0.seq.1.1.n: 塔姆辛接过了守钟人的绳子。到夜里，她就认不出你们的脸了。
content.fx.the-last-vesper.oc.choose.1.seq.1.0.n: 守望结束了。灰色从岩石里涌出，漫过城墙。
content.fx.the-last-vesper.oc.choose.1.seq.1.1.n: 走在路上，你试着回想那座城堡叫什么名字。
content.fx.the-porter.done.0.narrate: 岩架贴着城墙往西延伸，另一边什么也没有。
content.fx.the-ringer-unmade.oc.climb-to-the-bel: 楼梯空了。雨又下了起来。
content.fx.the-wardens-key.done.1.narrate: 守钟人之门在城堡最高处。东城墙一路通到那里。
content.fx.the-wardens-ledger.done.0.narrate: 一股冷风从阶梯下涌上来。
content.fx.the-wardens-ledger.oc.read-the-ledger: “第10811日。敲了晚祷钟。失去：发大水那年的解冻月初八。那天好像有一首歌。”
“第10954日。我问学徒叫什么名字，她哭了。我把她的名字写在了手上。”
“最后一页。若我敲不动她了：守钟人的阶梯在圣咏集后面。总得有人把钟舌扛回来。”
content.fx.trig.portcullis-reply.0.narrate: 铁闸从这一侧抬不起来。
content.lethal.undertide.message: 灰色的水先带走你的名字，再带走你剩下的一切。

content.obj.the-bell-road.meet-halvard-again.hin: 他在城墙北端的瞭望塔里。

敲门没有用。锁孔又老又大。
content.obj.the-bell-road.survive-the-knives.hin: 有人花钱让他们在这儿等着。
content.obj.the-bell-road.survive-the-knives.tit: 从雇来的刀手手里活下来

碎片嗡嗡作响，在等它的钟舌。
content.obj.the-bell-road.walk-the-buttresses.hi: 从瞭望塔沿高空步道往西。

content.obj.the-cliff-path.put-down-the-grooms.h: 他们正从马栏里站起来。

content.obj.the-porter.unlock-the-postern.missin: 侧门锁着。门卫身上有钥匙。

它在本该挂钟的地方甩着一根绳子。

content.quest.beneath-the-psalter.goal: 穿过守钟人墓穴，下到遗忘之潮池，把钟掉下去的钟舌拿回来。
content.quest.the-bell-road.goal: 登上东城墙，经过瞭望塔和塔里的小贩，用回响中得到的钥匙打开守钟人之门，听钟塔的回响。
content.quest.the-causeway-fire.goal: 收下塔姆辛的钱，点起堤道脚下的火。
content.quest.the-chapel-echo.goal: 把钟舌带给塔姆辛，唤醒礼拜堂祭坛上的碎片。
content.quest.the-cliff-path.goal: 沿悬崖岩架绕到马厩，从马夫手里活下来，进入外庭。
content.quest.the-cloister-fire.goal: 找到回廊，点起那里的火，听那位守望的骑士把话说完。
content.quest.the-keep.goal: 穿过钟声打开的主堡大门，杀穿被遗忘的卫队，抵达王座之火。
content.quest.the-king-who-kept-the-watch.goal: 直面那位没有名字、守了十年王座的国王。
content.quest.the-last-vesper.goal: 与塔姆辛一起决定：这口钟，和被它锁住的城堡，将何去何从。
content.quest.the-porter.goal: 穿过堤道，击倒把守门楼的门卫，用他的钥匙打开侧门。
content.quest.the-ringer-unmade.goal: 击倒钟楼里那个敲钟的东西，挂回钟舌，把裂了的钟敲响一次，听钟楼记得什么。
content.quest.the-wardens-key.goal: 在礼拜堂的回响中听守钟人说话，拿走她挂在钩子上的钥匙。
content.quest.the-wardens-ledger.goal: 在缮写室读守钟人的账簿，找到它指出的下去的路。
content.shop.pellam.offer.0.label: 箭，15
content.shop.pellam.offer.0.tooltip: 十六支箭，箭羽来自某个曾经是鹅的东西。
content.shop.pellam.offer.1.label: 金苹果，60
content.shop.pellam.offer.1.tooltip: “国王餐桌上的。”他说。其实不是。
content.shop.pellam.offer.2.label: 铁矛，35
content.shop.pellam.offer.2.tooltip: “朝圣者的手杖。”他这么说的是一杆矛座上还带着血的猎猪矛。
content.shop.pellam.offer.3.label: 弩，45
content.shop.pellam.offer.3.tooltip: 从一个死去的门卫身上拿的。弦是新换的，他对此颇为自豪。
content.shop.pellam.offer.4.label: 钻石剑，100
content.shop.pellam.offer.4.tooltip: “在祭坛上祝圣过的。”这座城堡里十年来没有任何东西被祝圣过。
content.shop.pellam.offer.5.label: 亡灵杀手 III 附魔书，70
content.shop.pellam.offer.5.tooltip: “守钟人亲手抄的。”他说；那笔迹是他自己的。拿到铁砧上，把它打进你的兵器里。
content.shop.pellam.offer.6.label: 保护 II 附魔书，50
content.shop.pellam.offer.6.tooltip: “什么刀剑都挡得住。”他说。挡得住一些。
content.shop.pellam.offer.7.label: 力量 II 附魔书，55
content.shop.pellam.offer.7.tooltip: 他说这是给弓手的赞美诗集。诗里唱的全是鹅。
content.shop.pellam.offer.8.label: 铁剑（亡灵杀手 II），80
content.shop.pellam.offer.8.tooltip: “教堂司事自己的剑。”他承认，那位司事是带着它下葬的，说不定还想要回去。
content.shop.pellam.offer.9.label: 一个秘密，10
content.shop.pellam.offer.9.tooltip: 佩拉姆凑过来，要把出路卖给你。

source.dlg.halvard.halvard-choice.opt.0.label: Go home, Halvard.
source.dlg.halvard.halvard-choice.opt.0.tooltip: The man on the throne is not the king you swore to.
source.dlg.halvard.halvard-choice.opt.1.label: Hold the door.
source.dlg.halvard.halvard-choice.opt.1.tooltip: The king still needs his door held.
source.dlg.halvard.halvard-choice.opt.2.label: What will you do?
source.dlg.halvard.halvard-choice.text: "You went up and down this castle. Tell me plainly. Is my king alive? If he is not, say so, and I will go home. If he is, I will go ahead of you and hold his door."
source.dlg.halvard.halvard-cloister.opt.0.label: We don't know yet.
source.dlg.halvard.halvard-cloister.opt.1.label: What door?
source.dlg.halvard.halvard-cloister.text: "Friends of the watch. Ser Halvard Dray, sworn to the king's door. I cannot recall which door. Have you seen the king? Does he live?"
source.dlg.halvard.halvard-dont-know.text: "Then I keep the watch until you do. I will be honest with you: I am afraid you will come back and tell me he is dead, and then I will not know what I am for."
source.dlg.halvard.halvard-door.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.halvard.halvard-door.text: "Every morning I choose one and stand at it. It seems the least I can do."
source.dlg.halvard.halvard-tower.opt.0.label: Ask your question.
source.dlg.halvard.halvard-tower.opt.1.label: Later.
source.dlg.halvard.halvard-tower.text: Halvard has moved his watch to the top of the wall. "Friends of the watch. The wall is not safe yet. When it is, I have a question for you."
source.dlg.halvard.halvard-what.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.halvard.halvard-what.text: "Whatever you tell me. I have been choosing a door every morning for ten years. I am tired of choosing."
source.dlg.ilse-hesk.hesk-cost.opt.0.label: Who is the girl?
source.dlg.ilse-hesk.hesk-cost.opt.1.label: Why keep ringing?
source.dlg.ilse-hesk.hesk-cost.text: "A day for every ringing. I write down which one, so something keeps it." She reads: "'The eighth of Thaw. It had a song in it.' I don't know the song any more. Only that there was one."
source.dlg.ilse-hesk.hesk-girl.opt.0.label: Why keep ringing?
source.dlg.ilse-hesk.hesk-girl.text: "The apprentice. The ledger says she's my daughter." She says it without looking round. "I'm afraid of the day I won't know her even from the page. I'm afraid of it more than of the Undertide."
source.dlg.ilse-hesk.hesk-root.opt.0.label: What does it cost?
source.dlg.ilse-hesk.hesk-root.opt.1.label: Who is the girl?
source.dlg.ilse-hesk.hesk-root.text: The warden looks up from her ledger as if you had always been there. "Good morning. Are you new to the court? Everyone is new to me now. I ring the Vesper tonight."
source.dlg.ilse-hesk.hesk-why.opt.0.label: We'll remember.
source.dlg.ilse-hesk.hesk-why.text: "Because if I stop, the grey comes up and takes everyone's days at once instead of mine one by one." She hangs a heavy key on the hook by the altar. "The tower door. For whoever rings after me."
source.dlg.pellam.pellam-after.opt.0.label: You sold us.
source.dlg.pellam.pellam-after.opt.1.label: Goodbye.
source.dlg.pellam.pellam-after.text: Pellam won't meet your eye. "They paid more. You'd have done the same. The blanket's still open, if you're still buying."
source.dlg.pellam.pellam-monk.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.pellam.pellam-monk.text: "Of course. For years. Or I bought the habit from one." He frowns. "One of those is true."
source.dlg.pellam.pellam-root.opt.0.label: Where's it from?
source.dlg.pellam.pellam-root.opt.1.label: Were you a monk?
source.dlg.pellam.pellam-root.opt.2.label: Goodbye.
source.dlg.pellam.pellam-root.text: "Brother Pellam, friend to pilgrims, seller of what the dead don't need. My blanket's by the counter. Tallow only."
source.dlg.pellam.pellam-sold.opt.0.label: Goodbye.
source.dlg.pellam.pellam-sold.text: "I sell everything, friend. That's the one true thing about me."
source.dlg.pellam.pellam-where.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.pellam.pellam-where.text: "Here and there. Mostly there. As the saying goes, a coat on a corpse is a coat going cold."
source.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-hire.opt.0.label: What is the hold?
source.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-hire.opt.1.label: What do you want?
source.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-hire.opt.2.label: We'll go.
source.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-hire.text: "You're the ones who answered the notice. Sit. Eat something. The hold doesn't open for anyone, so you'll have to open it."
source.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-hold.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-hold.text: "Vesperhold. A king, a court, a bell. Ten years ago the bell stopped. Since then the gates stay shut and nobody inside remembers why they're keeping them shut."
source.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-throne.opt.0.label: Ring it again.
source.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-throne.opt.1.label: Let it stay quiet.
source.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-throne.opt.1.tooltip: The watch ends. The castle forgets itself.
source.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-throne.opt.2.label: Why tell us?
source.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-throne.text: Tamsin looks at the king for a long time. "I cracked the bell. I was fifteen. She'd have rung it that night and forgotten me the rest of the way, so I took a hammer to it." She holds up her mother's ledger. "It can ring again if somebody takes the rope. It'll be me. Or we let it stay quiet and let the grey out."
source.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-tongue.opt.0.label: Why not?
source.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-tongue.opt.1.label: To the chapel.
source.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-tongue.text: "That's her tongue. That's the Vesper's." She doesn't touch it. "There's a shard of her on the chapel altar. Hold that to it. The chapel will remember what it was like when she still rang. I'm not coming in."
source.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-want.opt.0.label: Who are you to it?
source.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-want.opt.1.label: Back.
source.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-want.text: "There's a piece of the bell somewhere under the castle. The tongue. I want it found. After that I don't know. I'm being honest about that part."
source.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-who.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-who.text: "I carried the warden's lantern once. That's all you need."
source.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-why-tell.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-why-tell.text: "Because you carried her up and down this castle. You get a say."
source.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-why.opt.0.label: To the chapel.
source.dlg.tamsin.tamsin-why.text: "Because I know what it'll show you. I'm afraid of it. Go."
source.dlg.young-tamsin.apprentice-hammer.text: "If there's no bell there's nothing to ring. That's all. That's the whole plan."
source.dlg.young-tamsin.apprentice-root.text: The girl doesn't look at you. "She asked me my name this morning. Twice. So don't tell me what's right. Tonight she's not ringing it."
source.fx.beneath-the-psalter.done.0.narrate: A stair climbs from the pool toward a door. Tamsin will want to see this.
The water is singing without a voice.
source.fx.death.1.narrate: You wake by the last fire you rested at. What you carried stayed where you fell.
source.fx.shop.pellam.0.0.narrate: Pellam spreads his hands. "Tallow first, friend."
source.fx.shop.pellam.1.0.narrate: Pellam spreads his hands. "Tallow first, friend."
source.fx.shop.pellam.2.0.narrate: Pellam spreads his hands. "Tallow first, friend."
source.fx.shop.pellam.3.0.narrate: Pellam spreads his hands. "Tallow first, friend."

source.fx.shop.pellam.5.0.narrate: Pellam spreads his hands. "Tallow first, friend."
source.fx.shop.pellam.6.0.narrate: Pellam spreads his hands. "Tallow first, friend."
source.fx.shop.pellam.7.0.narrate: Pellam spreads his hands. "Tallow first, friend."
source.fx.shop.pellam.8.0.narrate: Pellam spreads his hands. "Tallow first, friend."
source.fx.shop.pellam.9.0.narrate: Pellam spreads his hands. "Tallow first, friend."
source.fx.shop.pellam.9.1.narrate: "The bell tower door opens for anyone who knocks three times." He says it with great confidence.
source.fx.the-bell-road.done.0.narrate: The stair climbs to the belfry. Something up there is ringing without a bell.
Pellam's brazier. He charges for everything but the warmth.
source.fx.the-bell-road.oc.wake-the-second-shar: Overhead, a rope creaks where the bell should hang.
Pellam's voice, behind you: "Nothing personal, friends. They paid more."
source.fx.the-causeway-fire.oc.hear-tamsin.0.re: The fire takes the rain out of your coat.
source.fx.the-causeway-fire.oc.hear-tamsin.2.se: The postern is locked. The Porter had a key.
source.fx.the-causeway-fire.oc.hear-tamsin.3.se: The Keep Doors are barred from within.
source.fx.the-causeway-fire.oc.hear-tamsin.4.se: The Warden's Door is locked. The Warden kept the key.
source.fx.the-cloister-fire.oc.find-the-cloiste: Rain drips off the arcade. The garth is quiet.
source.fx.the-keep.oc.reach-the-antechamber.0.r: Behind the drapes, something very large breathes out.
source.fx.the-keep.oc.reach-the-antechamber.2.n: Ser Halvard stands in the doorway, sword in hand, head down. He has been dead for an hour. He is still holding the door.
source.fx.the-keep.oc.reach-the-antechamber.4.n: Scratched into the doorframe, fresh: "Gone home. H."
source.fx.the-king-who-kept-the-watch.done.0.na: The king says, very clearly: "Keep the gates shut." Then he does not say anything.
source.fx.the-last-vesper.oc.choose.0.seq.1.0.n: Down in the ward, a soldier reads the name on his bunk out loud.
source.fx.the-last-vesper.oc.choose.0.seq.1.1.n: Tamsin takes the warden's rope. By nightfall she will not know your faces.
source.fx.the-last-vesper.oc.choose.1.seq.1.0.n: The watch is over. Grey comes up out of the rock and over the walls.
source.fx.the-last-vesper.oc.choose.1.seq.1.1.n: On the road you try to remember what the castle was called.
source.fx.the-porter.done.0.narrate: The shelf runs west under the wall, with nothing on the other side of it.
source.fx.the-ringer-unmade.oc.climb-to-the-bel: The stair is empty. The rain is back.
source.fx.the-wardens-key.done.1.narrate: The Warden's Door is at the top of the castle. The east rampart climbs to it.
The key is still on the hook.
source.fx.the-wardens-ledger.done.0.narrate: A cold draught comes up the stair.
source.fx.the-wardens-ledger.oc.read-the-ledger: "Day 10,811. Rang the Vesper. Lost: the eighth of Thaw, the year of the flood. It had a song in it, I think."
"Day 10,954. The apprentice cried when I asked her name. I have written it on my hand."
"Last page. If I cannot ring her, the wardens' stair is behind the psalters. Somebody must carry the tongue back up."
source.fx.trig.portcullis-reply.0.narrate: The portcullis will not lift from this side.
source.fx.trig.warden-knight.0.narrate: The kneeling knight lifts his head.
source.fx.trig.well-house-reply.0.narrate: The door is barred from within.
source.lethal.undertide.message: The grey water takes your name first, and then the rest of you.
source.loot.garrison-blade.item.0.name: Garrison Blade
source.loot.garrison-hauberk.item.0.name: Garrison Hauberk
source.npc.halvard.name: Ser Halvard Dray
source.npc.ilse-hesk.name: Warden Ilse Hesk
source.npc.pellam.name: Brother Pellam
source.npc.tamsin.name: Tamsin Hesk
source.npc.young-tamsin.name: The Apprentice
Down the stair behind the psalters.
source.obj.beneath-the-psalter.find-the-pool.hi: North through the passage beyond the tombs.
It lies at the lip of the well.
source.obj.the-bell-road.climb-the-rampart.hint: The stair tower in the ward's north-east corner, then east along the spur.
source.obj.the-bell-road.meet-halvard-again.hin: He is in the watch tower at the north end of the wall.
The iron-bound door at the west end of the walk. Hold the Warden's Key to it.
Knocking does nothing. The keyhole is old and large.
source.obj.the-bell-road.survive-the-knives.hin: Somebody paid them to wait here.
A piece of the bell lies on the tower floor. Hold the tongue to it.
The shard hums, waiting for its tongue.
source.obj.the-bell-road.walk-the-buttresses.hi: West from the watch tower along the high walk.
source.obj.the-causeway-fire.cross-the-causeway: North up the pilgrim road, up the stair, and over the bridge to the gatehouse.
source.obj.the-causeway-fire.hear-tamsin.hint: The woman by the fire in the wayside shrine.
source.obj.the-causeway-fire.hear-tamsin.title: Speak with Tamsin
source.obj.the-chapel-echo.show-tamsin.hint: She is in the cloister arcade.
source.obj.the-chapel-echo.show-tamsin.title: Show Tamsin the tongue
source.obj.the-chapel-echo.wake-the-shard.hint: The humming piece of bell on the chapel altar, north of the cloister. Hold the tongue to it.
source.obj.the-chapel-echo.wake-the-shard.missi: The shard hums. It wants the rest of its bell.
source.obj.the-chapel-echo.wake-the-shard.title: Wake the shard
source.obj.the-cliff-path.clear-the-shelf.hint: Watchmen stand on the shelf ahead.
source.obj.the-cliff-path.clear-the-shelf.title: Clear the shelf
source.obj.the-cliff-path.enter-the-stables.hin: Round the corner of the crag and north along the west face, to the stable's back door.
source.obj.the-cliff-path.put-down-the-grooms.h: They are getting up out of the stalls.
source.obj.the-cliff-path.reach-the-ward.title: Reach the outer ward
source.obj.the-cliff-path.walk-the-shelf.hint: Out through the postern and west along the shelf.
source.obj.the-cliff-path.walk-the-shelf.title: Walk the cliff shelf
North-west corner of the ward, up the walled lane to the cloister.
source.obj.the-cloister-fire.hear-halvard.hint: The old knight under the east arcade.
source.obj.the-cloister-fire.hear-halvard.title: Speak with the watchman
source.obj.the-keep.break-the-guard.hint: They hold the hall in ranks.
source.obj.the-keep.break-the-guard.title: Break the Unremembered Guard
source.obj.the-keep.enter-the-keep.hint: Through the Keep Doors on the ward's north side.
source.obj.the-keep.enter-the-keep.title: Enter the keep
source.obj.the-keep.reach-the-antechamber.hint: Up the steps at the north end of the hall.
source.obj.the-keep.reach-the-antechamber.title: Reach the antechamber
source.obj.the-king-who-kept-the-watch.approach: Through the drapes, north of the Throne Fire.
source.obj.the-last-vesper.choose.hint: She has followed you to the throne.
source.obj.the-last-vesper.choose.title: Speak with Tamsin
source.obj.the-porter.put-down-the-porter.hint: Inside the gatehouse at the end of the causeway.
source.obj.the-porter.put-down-the-porter.title: Put down the Porter
source.obj.the-porter.take-the-postern-key.hint: The Porter carried it on his belt.
source.obj.the-porter.unlock-the-postern.hint: The small door in the gate tower's guard room, west of the gate hall.
source.obj.the-porter.unlock-the-postern.missin: The postern is locked. The Porter had a key.
source.obj.the-porter.unlock-the-postern.title: Unlock the postern
source.obj.the-ringer-unmade.ring-the-vesper.hi: Under the bell frame. Hold up the tongue.
source.obj.the-ringer-unmade.ring-the-vesper.mi: There is a bell frame and no bell. You carried its tongue up from the pool.
It is swinging a rope where the bell should hang.
source.obj.the-wardens-key.hear-the-warden.hint: The woman with the ledger at the altar.
source.obj.the-wardens-ledger.find-the-stair.hi: The ledger's last page names the psalter wall.
source.obj.the-wardens-ledger.read-the-ledger.h: In the scriptorium, south through the cloister.
source.quest.beneath-the-psalter.goal: Go down through the wardens' crypt to the Undertide Pool and take back the bell's fallen tongue.
source.quest.the-bell-road.goal: Climb the east rampart, get past the watch tower and its peddler, open the Warden's Door with the echo's key, and hear the tower's echo.
source.quest.the-causeway-fire.goal: Take Tamsin's coin and light the fire at the foot of the causeway.
source.quest.the-chapel-echo.goal: Bring the tongue to Tamsin and wake the shard on the chapel altar.
source.quest.the-cliff-path.goal: Follow the cliff ledge round to the stables, survive the grooms, and come out into the outer ward.
source.quest.the-cloister-fire.goal: Find the cloister, light its fire, and hear out the knight keeping watch there.
source.quest.the-keep.goal: Go through the Keep Doors the bell opened, cut through the Unremembered Guard, and reach the Throne Fire.
source.quest.the-king-who-kept-the-watch.goal: Face the king who has held the throne for ten years without a name.
source.quest.the-last-vesper.goal: Decide, with Tamsin, what becomes of the bell and the castle it held shut.
source.quest.the-porter.goal: Cross the causeway, put down the Porter who holds the barbican, and unlock the postern with its key.
source.quest.the-ringer-unmade.goal: Put down the thing that rings in the belfry, hang the tongue, ring the cracked bell once, and hear what the belfry remembers.
source.quest.the-wardens-key.goal: Hear the warden in the chapel's echo, and take the key she leaves on the hook.
source.quest.the-wardens-ledger.goal: Read the bell-warden's ledger in the scriptorium and find the way down it points to.
source.shop.pellam.offer.0.label: Arrows, 15
source.shop.pellam.offer.0.tooltip: Sixteen arrows, fletched with something that was a goose once.
source.shop.pellam.offer.1.label: Golden apple, 60
source.shop.pellam.offer.1.tooltip: "From the king's own table," he says. It is not.
source.shop.pellam.offer.2.label: Iron spear, 35
source.shop.pellam.offer.2.tooltip: "A pilgrim's staff," he says, of a boar spear still bloody at the socket.
source.shop.pellam.offer.3.label: Crossbow, 45
source.shop.pellam.offer.3.tooltip: Off a dead gate-warden. The string is new; he is proud of that.
source.shop.pellam.offer.4.label: Diamond sword, 100
source.shop.pellam.offer.4.tooltip: "Blessed at the altar." Nothing in this castle has been blessed in ten years.
source.shop.pellam.offer.5.label: Book of Smite III, 70
source.shop.pellam.offer.5.tooltip: "Copied in the Warden's own hand," he says; the hand is his. Work it into your weapon at the anvil.
source.shop.pellam.offer.6.label: Book of Protection II, 50
source.shop.pellam.offer.6.tooltip: "Proof against any blade," he says. Against some.
source.shop.pellam.offer.7.label: Book of Power II, 55
source.shop.pellam.offer.7.tooltip: A hymnal for archers, he says. The hymns are about geese.
source.shop.pellam.offer.8.label: Iron sword, Smite II, 80
source.shop.pellam.offer.8.tooltip: "The sexton's own." The sexton, he admits, was buried with it, and may want it back.
source.shop.pellam.offer.9.label: A secret, 10
source.shop.pellam.offer.9.tooltip: Pellam leans in to sell you the way through.
source.shop.pellam.title: Brother Pellam's Blanket
